It is for enjoyment and conversation, not a test, and it does not treat or slow dementia. If it causes frustration, try Find the same or simply look at pictures together.

color-by-number.h1: Ziiwaabigan Biibaagaade: Dibaajimowinan Gaawiin, Ziiwaabigan Wii-Waabamaad
color-by-number.description: A grid of large numbered squares and a key of four colors with their names. Choose a color, then tap squares to fill them. Any color is fine, there is no timer or score, and a button fills the rest by the numbers. Free to play and print.
color-by-number.short: Ziiwaabigan wiiyaawin, maage gaawiin wiinawaa biibaagaadegan...
color-by-number.intro: A square grid of large squares, each with a number, and a key above it with four colors, each with its number and its written name. Choose a color from the key, then tap squares to fill them. The grid is 4 by 4 to start, with 6 by 6 and 8 by 8 when you want more squares. When every square has the color of its number, the grid is the picture on the sheet. Squares filled with any other color are simply your own picture, and the game says nothing about it. "Fill with the numbers" fills every empty square for you.
howTo: Choose the grid size. 4 by 4 has the biggest squares and is the simplest.
Look at the key above the grid. Each color has a number and a name, such as 1 Yellow.
Tap a color in the key, then tap the squares you would like to fill with it.
Use the color on the number, or any color you like. Both are fine.
Tap "Fill with the numbers" for the empty squares, "Clear" to start the grid again, or "Another picture" for a different one.
tips: Sit side by side and take turns: one person chooses the color, the other taps the square.
Talk about the colors: "I like the green." There is no need to name what the picture will be.
On a narrow screen the 8 by 8 grid scrolls sideways inside its own box. The squares stay a comfortable size.
The paper version works as well with pencils at a bedside table.

faq.q: Aaniin maage gaa-ziibaakwaan ziiwaabigan biibaagaadeg wiinawaa?

story-dice.name: Dibaajimo-dice
story-dice.description: Niswi miinwaa niiwin mazinaate'iwin dice gaa-dibaajimo, gaa-ayaad gaa-ezhi-ayaad. Gaawiin gaa-giiwe-dibaajimo, gaawiin gaa-ayaad gaa-ganawenimaa, gaawiin ginwenzh. Gaa-giiwe-ayaad gaa-ayaad, miinwaa gaa-ayaad gaa-nisaadaan.

story-dice.players: Niizh miinwaa gaa-ayaad, miinwaa mindimooye miinwaa abinoojii
story-dice.intro: Three or four pictures are shown, like dice. Together, make up a story that uses them, in any order. A story can be one sentence or a few, and it can be silly or true to life. There is no right story, and nobody has to name or remember anything. Tap "Roll again" for new pictures, and anyone may pass.
howTo: Choose three or four dice. Three is the simplest.
Look at the pictures together. Tap one if you would like to begin with it.
Take turns telling a story that uses the pictures, in any order. One sentence each is plenty.
Anyone may pass. Tap "Pass" and the next person can start.
Tap "Roll again" for new pictures whenever you like, or tap Rest to stop.
tips: Ask a question rather than waiting for an answer: "Where might the umbrella be going?"
Add to what the last person said instead of correcting it. Any story works.
A story can be about a real memory. A picture is a good start for one.

word-and-picture-pairs.h1: Word and Picture Pairs: Match the Word to the Picture
word-and-picture-pairs.description: Match English words to their pictures, and hear any word read aloud. Pictures stay in view, with no timer, score or count of tries. Free to play and print.
word-and-picture-pairs.short: Match each word to its picture, and hear it read aloud.
word-and-picture-pairs.intro: Four or six pictures are shown, with their English words in a different order. Tap a word and then its picture, or a picture and then its word. A matched pair stays together with a thick border and the word "Matched". Tap "Read aloud" beside any word to hear it spoken. Nothing is timed or scored, and a tap that does not match simply clears itself.
howTo: Choose four or six pictures. Four is the simplest.
Tap a word, then the picture it names. Or tap a picture first, then its word.
A matched pair stays together. A tap that does not match clears quietly, so try another.
Tap "Read aloud" beside a word to hear it, if your device can read text aloud.
Tap "New pictures" for another set, or "Start again" to take every pair apart. "Put it back" brings back the last matches.
tips: Say each word aloud together before you match it, and talk about the picture.
Families can take turns. Each person chooses one word or picture at a time.
Use the words you already know first, and leave the others for later.

photo-pairs.name: Niizhoo-mazinaakiziganan
photo-pairs.description: Gidinawemaaganag omazinaakiziganiwaan aabaji' e-ozhitood begish nasawaabi-odaminowin. Onaabandan 2 debishgoo' 6 mazinaakiziganan omaa gid-aabajichiganing; omaa eta browser-ing atewan, gaawiin ningoji aazhodaabaanigaadesinoon.
photo-pairs.short: Onaabandan gi-mazinaakiziganan miinawaa nasawaabidaan. Gaawiin gegoo aazhodaabaanigaadenoog.
photo-pairs.intro: Chooz two to six of your own family photos from your phone, tablet or computer, and they become a matching game with large, visible pictures. The photos are shown only inside this page. They are not uploaded, saved or shared, and they disappear when you close the page. If you like, add a few words under each photo, and a gentle hint can point to one pair after a pause. This is a way of looking at family photos together.
howTo: Tap “Choose photos” and pick two to six photos.
Each photo appears twice. Tap one, then tap its pair.
If you like, add a few words under each photo. Captions are not saved.
Talk about each photo as you find it.
When you are done, close the page or tap “Clear photos”. Nothing is kept.
tips: Onaabandan gwayak-mazinaakiziganan minwendamowin miinawaa gakina awiya gaa-nagadenimowaad: awesiinyens, gitigaan, minwendang danakiiwin, gemaa wiidigendi-giizhigad.

Mazinaakiziganan danakiiwin miinawaa aabajichiganan noonde-nanaandawendamo-inaabinjigad iwidi zhiibimaaji'aang ezhi-nagadenimangwaa bemaadizijig, gaawiin dash awiya da-gagwedwe ji-wiindamaaged awenen aawid.
Gego aabajitoosiken gaa-ishkwaa-bimaadizijig omazinaakiziganiwaan giishpin nishiwanenjige-inakamigak, baamaa gwayak kekendaman minwendamoog.

faq.a: Gaawiin ningoji. Omaa mazinaatesichiganing agindam mazinaakiziganan gaa-onaabandaman omaa gi-browser-ing miinawaa waabandahiwemagad omaa gi-mazinaatesichiganing. Gaawiin maajii-aazhoodaabaanigaadesinoon ninanang gemaa awiya bakaan, mii dash wanisewag giishpin giba'aman gemaa minawaa maadaadaman.
Gaawiin. Gaawiin dagonzisinook diba'igiizhiswan, agindaasowin, gemaa wanitoowin. Gidaa-boonitaa aaniin apii menwendaman, mii go naawayi'ii ji-boonitaayan gwayak mino-gwekajiwin.

Gaawiin omaa browser-ing, gwayak wenji-ozhigaadeg ji-ganawenjigaadenook gegoo gaa-inaabandaman. O'ow bina Creative Activities app omaa iPhone miinawaa iPad da-gashkitoon ji-ganawendang omaa gid-aabajichiganing.

picture-bingo.name: Mazinaakizigan-bingo
picture-bingo.description: Bingo mashkawaji-giigaatewinan ji-biindigejigaade, ji-gii-bagijigaade wiijiiwag, gichi-dodemag miinwaa dibikoonag. Gichi-dibaajimowinan miinwaa dibaajimowinan, 9 ge 16 wiinwiganan, miinwaa dibaajimo ji-bizindaagoonjigaade.
picture-bingo.intro: Bwaanawi-bingo mazinaakiziganan aabajichigaadewan mii dash gaawiin agindaasowinan, mii dash gaawiin awiya da-nanaandawendamoosiin ji-agindang biindig agaasaag. Maziniganaandaan mazinaakiziganan, mii dash aabajitoon mazinaatesichigan ji-waabandahiweng gichi-mindido mazinaakizigan omaa TV, mazinaabikiwebiniganing gemaa tablet.
howTo: Onaabandan 9 gemaa 16 mazinaakiziganan endaso-maziniganing miinawaa aaniin minik bemaadizijig.
Daminikwen "Maziniganaandaan maziniganan". Endaso-mazinigan baakaanigo-ate.
Baakinan mazinaatesichigan mindidong. Daminikwen "Mina-mazinaakizigan" ji-waabandahiweng endaso-mazinaakizigan wiingashk-ikidowin.
Bemaadizijig od-agwanawaan nasawaabi-mazinaakizigan omaa omaziniganiwaang zhooniyaansens, gichi-biiwaabikoons, gemaa mazinaate-aabajichigans.
Awiya gakina gaa-mooshkinebinaad niizhi-nibeg gemaa gakina maziniganing minwaabanjigaazo. Gaawiin awiya bi-wanitoosiin: odaminoog aaniin apii gakina awiya gashkitoowaad bezhig niizhi-nibeg.
tips: Aabajitoon mindido-aabajichiganensag checkers gemaa omoondayan. Agaasaa-giizhikensag sanagiziwag ji-onda'amang.
Wiindamaw mazinaakizigan miinawaa gego inaajimotan: "Jiimaan. Awenen gaa-bimaadagewid jiimaaning?"
Abishinowaad bemaadizijig zeginaagwadinig besho omaa mazinaatesichiganing, miinawaa wiidookaw bemaadizijig nandawendangig wiidookawaagewin.
9 mazinaakiziganan debise gakina awiya. Gwayak ganawendan 20 debishgoo' 30 diba'iganensan.

faq.q: Aaniin ge-zhi-doodamaan ji-odaminong mazinaakizigan-bingo omaa gechi-aya'aag owaakaa'iganiwaang?
faq.a: Maziniganaandaan bezhig mazinigan endaso-bemaadizid, atoon noondaagozid omaa mamawi-mindidong mazinaatesichiganing, miinawaa bedoseyan wiindamaw mazinaakiziganan, wiindamaw endaso-bezhig. Odaminog aaniin apii gakina awiya gashkitoowaad, mii dash gaawiin awiya da-naganaasosiin.
Enyaa. Maziniganaandaan aaniin minik nandawendaman maziniganan, aaniin apii nandawendaman, giin igo gemaa maamawi-odaminooyan.
Enyaa. Endaso-ate mindido mazinaakizigan, anaamayi'ii atewan ikidowinan awiya menwendangig ikidowinan.

picnic-planner.name: Ji-mazinaachigaade dibikwaan
picnic-planner.h1: Ji-mazinaachigaade Dibikwaan: Mashkawaji-giigaatewinan Chooz, Ge-ayaad Ji-bi-wiijiiwaad
picnic-planner.description: Chooz mashkawaji-giigaatewinan ji-miijim miinwaa ji-gaa-bimaadiziwaad ji-mazinaachigaade dibikwaan, ge-ayaad gii-wiijiiwaad. Gaawiin dibikwaan bebezhig gaa-mazinaachigaadeg. Mashkawaji-giigaatewin ji-bizindaan miinwaa ji-bizindaagoonjigaade.
picnic-planner.short: Chooz mashkawaji-miijimowinan miinwaa ji-gaa-bimaadiziwaad ji-mazinaachigaade dibikwaan, ge-ayaad gii-wiijiiwaad.
picnic-planner.intro: Tap mashkawaji-giigaatewinan miijim miinwaa gaa-bimaadiziwaad ji-bi-ginaagaade ji-gii-miigwechiwendam dibikwaan, ji-gii-noojimo dibikwaan niizh-tikinagan. Dibaajimowin ji-gii-ikidod gaa-bimaadiziwaad, mii ezhi-ikidod: “Dibikwaan: bakwezhigan, warwe, opin miinwaa oshki-gaa-ginoodamaagewaad.” Ge-tap “Ji-wiijiiwaad dibikwaan” ji-bi-wiijiiwaad. Mashkawaji-giigaatewinan gaa-bi-ayaawag, gaawiin dibaajimo, gaawiin ji-gii-gashkitoowaad. “Ji-bizhikeyaadaa dibikwaan” ji-gii-bizhikeyaad gaa-mazinaachigaade dibaajimowin ji-gii-ikidod.
howTo: Tap mashkawaji-giigaatewin miijim gaa-bimaadiziwaad. Ji-bi-noojimo dibikwaan.
Tap mashkawaji-giigaatewin dibikwaan ji-bi-gaa-ginaagaade.
Chooz niizh dibaajimowinan, ge-tap “Ji-wiijiiwaad dibikwaan”.
Tap niizh gaa-ayaawag mashkawaji-giigaatewinan. Mashkawaji-giigaatewinan ji-bi-ayaawag, gaawiin ji-gii-ayaawag ji-bi-gaa-gaanaagaade.
Tap “Ji-bizhikeyaadaa dibikwaan” ji-gii-bizhikeyaad ji-gii-bi-ayaad, wiijiiwag ji-bi-ayaad.
tips: Dibaajim wiijiiwag gaa-bi-ayaawag dibikwaan gaa-ayaad, miinwaa chooz mashkawaji-giigaatewinan wiijiiwaad.
Dibaajim mashkawaji-giigaatewin gaa-bi-noojimo: “Gii-dibaajimaa ishkwaa gii-bimaadiziwaad? Ogichidaa-gaa-miijiwaad.”
Mashkawaji-giigaatewinan, ginoodamaagewinan ji-ginoodamaagewaad gaa-ikidowaad, ji-gii-bi-ayaawaad dibikwaan ji-gii-ayaawaad.

faq.a: No. Nothing is timed or counted, and nobody wins. The matching round has no misses and no points.
Gaawiin. Mii dash mashkawaji-giigaatewin ji-dibaajimaad ji-gii-bimaadiziwaad, ji-gii-ikidowaad miinwaa ji-gii-ginoodamaagewaad. Gaawiin gaa-ikidowaad, gaawiin gaa-miijiwaad.

faq.q: Ayaawag gaa-gii-noojimowaad mashkawaji-giigaatewinan, gaawiin gaa-gii-mazinaachigaadeg ge-gii-ginoodamaagewaad?
faq.a: Gaawiin. Dibikwaan ayaa ge-ayaad ii-page dash. Gaawiin gaa-mazinaachigaadeg, gaawiin gaa-noojimowaad, gaawiin gaa-ginoodamaagewaad, miinwaa gaa-gii-gashkitoowaad ishkwaa gaa-ginoodamaagewaad.
Ahaw. “Ji-bizhikeyaadaa dibikwaan” ji-bizhikeyaad bebezhig page, A4 ge US Letter. Mashkawaji-giigaatewinan gaa-noojimowaad, tick box ezhi-ayaad, miinwaa gaa-ikidowaad ge-ayaad gii-ginoodamaagewaad.
Ahaw, bizhikeyaadaa. Gaawiin account, sign-up, download gaa-ayaadeg. Ayaa ge-bi-ayaad web browser ji-bi-ayaad phone, tablet, computer.

scrapbook.name: Dibaajimowin-Mazinaachigan
scrapbook.h1: Dibaajimowin-Mazinaachigan: Noojimo Mashkawaji-Giigaatewinan miinwaa Dibaajimowinan, Ge-Gashkitoowaad Pagenan
scrapbook.description: Chooz niizh ji-niizh-tikinagan mashkawaji-giigaatewinan wiijiiwag gaa-bimaadiziwaad, ji-gashkitoowaad ezhi-ayaad dibaajimowin, miinwaa dibaajimo ji-ikidowaad. Gaawiin ji-bi-noojimo. Bizhikeyaadaa ji-bizhikeyaad.
scrapbook.short: Gashkitoowaad wiijiiwag gaa-bimaadiziwaad mashkawaji-giigaatewinan, ezhi-ayaad ji-mazinaachigaade.
scrapbook.intro: Chooz niizh ji-niizh-tikinagan mashkawaji-giigaatewinan gaa-ayaad ji-bi-ayaad. Bebezhig mashkawaji-giigaatewin mii dash bebezhig page dibaajimowin, gichi-wiinwiga miinwaa bebezhig ji-ikidowaad dibaajimowin. Ge-ayaad ji-gashkitoowaad botaan ge-ayaad keyboard arrow, miinwaa “Look together” ji-bi-ayaad wiijiiwag mashkawaji-giigaatewinan miinwaa dibaajimowinan. Mashkawaji-giigaatewinan ayaa gaa-ayaad ge-ayaad device. Gaawiin ji-noojimo, gaawiin gaa-mazinaachigaadeg, miinwaa page gaa-gashkitoowaad. “Print the scrapbook” ji-bizhikeyaad bebezhig mashkawaji-giigaatewin, dibaajimowin miinwaa page nambiwiin.
howTo: Tap “Choose photos” miinwaa chooz niizh ji-niizh-tikinagan mashkawaji-giigaatewinan. Dibaajim ge-ayaad gaa-ayaad, gaawiin ji-gii-giigaatewaad.
Gashkitoowaad pagenan “Previous page” miinwaa “Next page”, miinwaa Left miinwaa Right arrow keys.
Ge-ikidowaad dibaajimowin mashkawaji-giigaatewin ezhi-ayaad. “Move earlier” miinwaa “Move later” ji-bi-ayaad ji-bi-gaa-miigwechiwendam.
Tap “Look together” ji-bi-gaa-ayaad ji-bi-gaa-bizhikeyaadaa miinwaa ji-bi-gaa-bi-ayaad wiijiiwag.
Tap “Print the scrapbook” ji-bi-bizhikeyaad, miinwaa “Clear the book” gaa-ayaad. Gaawiin gaa-mazinaachigaadeg.
tips: Ahnjiyaan ezhi-gikinoo'amaagewin ekiijiiyaan: gichi-zhiibaa, ogonzhiibaa, mashkawiziwin/mashkawiziwin ezhi-giiyaan. Ezhi-ginawaajimowaad wiinawaa ekinamaajiiyaan idash.
Ahnjiyaan ezhi-gigii-awaabiijiyaan ishkwaa gaa-ayaad, oganohkaawaad wiinawaa idash — gaawiin ookaa gaa-ogii-nanaagadawaad ayaasiwin gaa-ogikaawaad. Gigii-gagiinaasiwaan-gaawin ogii-gikinawaajimowaad.
Ginooshkamigaamagad, ayaawaad gidanaagooman-gikaabiimagad gaa-zhishaad. Gikinawaajimowaad ogii-ginawaajimowaad ginoodiwaad nemiwaad mii enidaad.

faq.q: Ayaawaa biiboon eniigaaniin, wiinawaa biiboon ogii-maajiwaan?
faq.a: Gaawiin. Gaawiin ezhi-biiboon, wiinawaa ogii-maajiwaan, wiinawaa ezhi-gigikinamaagooyan, gaawiin mii ishkwaa ezhi-nagamowaad. Ogiiwiin gaa-zhishaad wiijiiyaang oganaajimaan ayaadaa ezhi-zhishaad.

faq.q: Gaa-ogii-dagoshinaan ezhi-zhiishimaan wiinawaa gaa-ogii-aanokiiwaan gaa-ozhibiigaadoon, ginawaajimowaad?
faq.a: Gaawiin. Ogii-gikinawaajimo ayaad ezhibiigaadaan ahnjiyaan, gaawiin ezhi-ginoowaajimo, gaawiin ezhi-gigii-gigikinamaagooyan ayaasiwin. Gaa-gii-gizhiwebanaan ayaad, gaa-ogii-gikinawaajimoon gaa-ayaad. Gii-gaaniinaaganaan ayaad, ezhi-gikinawaajimowin gaa-ayaad.
Ahaaw. "Gikinawaajimo" ezhi-gigii-gigikinamaagooyan bekaan ayaad, ahnjiyaan ayaasiwin ezhi-gigii-gigikinamaagooyan. Ezhi-ginawaajimo A4 mii ezhi-ginawaajimo US Letter gaa-ayaad gaa-zhiiwebanaan.
Ahaaw, gaawiin dibaajimowin gaa-dasiwaad, gaawiin ezhi-gaa-bi-gaadaawaad. Gaa-gii-nisaad ayaad, gaa-ayaad web browser ayaad, ekiijiiyaan, tablet ayaad, computer ayaad.

collage-board.name: Collage board
collage-board.seoTitle: Collage Board: Two People Place Pictures in Turns
collage-board.h1: Collage Board: Place Pictures on One Board, in Turns
collage-board.description: Two people take turns placing cut-out pictures on one shared board. Tap a cut-out, then an empty place. No timer or score. Free to play and print.
collage-board.short: Take turns placing pictures on one shared board.
collage-board.intro: Two people sit side by side with one board of twelve places and a tray of eight cut-out pictures. Tap a cut-out, then tap an empty place, and the picture goes there. The turn then passes to the other person. Each person's pictures carry their own shape, a circle or a square, so the board shows who placed what without relying on color. Either person may pass, and one step can be taken back. Nothing is timed, scored or saved. "Print the board" prints the empty board and the pictures to cut out.
howTo: Tap a cut-out in the tray. It shows "Chosen" while it is selected.
Tap an empty place on the board. The cut-out goes there, and the turn passes.
Either person can tap Pass at any time, or "Take back the last piece" to undo one step.
Tap "Another set of pictures" for a different tray. Pictures already on the board stay where they are.
Tap "Start again" to clear the board, and "Put it back" if you change your mind.
tips: Say the name of each picture as it goes down, such as "the teacup goes by the house". Talking makes it a shared activity.
Let the two people take turns choosing the cut-out as well as the place, so each has a say.
On paper, cut out the eight pictures with an adult helping, then place them on the printed boxes.

faq.q: Is there a timer, a score or a winner?
faq.a: No. Nothing is timed, scored or counted, and nobody wins. A full board is simply one with a picture in every place.

faq.q: Are the pictures we place saved or sent?
faq.a: No. The board stays on this page only. It is not saved, uploaded or counted, and it is gone when you close the page.

faq.q: How do we tell whose picture is whose?
faq.a: Each person has a shape. The first person's pictures have a circle in the corner, and the second person's have a square, with each name shown above the board.
Yes. "Print the board" prints the empty board as twelve boxes, with the eight pictures below at the same size, and the cutting line. An adult can do the cutting.

faq.q: Is it free, and do I need to sign up?
faq.a: Yes, it is free, and there is no account, sign-up or download. It works in the web browser on a phone, tablet or computer.

garden-planner.name: Garden planner
garden-planner.seoTitle: Garden Planner: Lay Out a Plot from Plant Pictures
garden-planner.h1: Garden Planner: Choose Pictures and Lay Out a Plot
garden-planner.description: Choose pictures of plants and garden things, then place them in twelve beds of a plot. Tap a picture, then a bed. No timer or score. Free to play and print.
garden-planner.short: Choose plant pictures and lay out a plot of twelve beds.
garden-planner.players: Solo, or 2 people side by side
garden-planner.intro: Choose pictures from a tray of plants and garden things, then tap a bed to put each one in place. A plot has twelve beds, and a bed holds one picture. A summary in words says what the plan has, such as "Your plan has 3 sunflowers, 2 roses and 1 tree." Nothing is timed, scored or saved, and there are no turns. This is a picture plan to talk about, not planting advice. "Print the plan" prints the beds with the pictures you chose, with blank beds to draw in and lines for notes.
howTo: Tap a picture in the tray. It shows "Chosen" while it is selected.
Tap a bed. The picture goes there, and the choice is put down.
To change a bed, choose another picture and tap the bed. To clear a bed, tap it with no picture chosen.
Tap "Start again" to empty every bed, and "Put it back" if you change your mind.
Tap "Print the plan" for a paper copy of the plot and the summary.
tips: Talk about each picture as it goes in, such as "ᐋᔑᓂᐦᐃᑯᐦᐃ ᐋᓇᓂᐦᐃᑯᐦᐃ" — the sunflower goes by the birdhouse. Talking makes it a shared activity.
Let each person choose a picture in turn, or choose the pictures together, so both have a say in the plot.
On paper, the blank beds are for drawing in your own ideas, and the notes lines are for anything you want to remember.

faq.a: No. This is a picture plan to talk about, not planting advice. It does not say when, where or how to plant anything, because that depends on where you live.

faq.q: Is there a timer, a score or a winner?
faq.a: No. Nothing is timed, scored, rated or counted, and nobody wins. A full plot gets no special message.

faq.q: Are the pictures we choose saved or sent?
faq.a: No. The plan stays on this page only. It is not saved, uploaded or counted, and it is gone when you close the page.
Yes. "Print the plan" prints one page, on A4 or US Letter. It shows the twelve beds with the pictures you chose, the summary in words, and blank lines for notes.

faq.q: Is it free, and do I need to sign up?
faq.a: Yes, it is free, and there is no account, sign-up or download. It works in the web browser on a phone, tablet or computer.

coloring-wall.name: Group coloring wall
coloring-wall.seoTitle: Group Coloring Wall: One Picture for Many Hands
coloring-wall.h1: Group Coloring Wall: One Big Picture, Colored Together
coloring-wall.description: Print one large picture across several pages, so a family, a class or a care home can color one wall together. Free to print. No timer or score.
coloring-wall.short: Print one big picture across pages for many people to color.
coloring-wall.players: A group, at a table or on a wall
coloring-wall.intro: Choose a picture from the coloring pages and a wall of 4, 6 or 9 pages. Print the wall: the first page shows how to put it together, and each of the other pages is one part of the same big picture, with a label such as A1 in its corner. Each person colors one or more pages, in any colors and any style. The pages are then laid out by their labels and joined with tape on the back. Nothing is timed, scored or saved.
howTo: Choose a picture, then choose how many pages the wall has.
Read the map on the screen, which shows where each label goes.
Tap "Print the wall" and print all the pages.
Give each person one or more pages to color. Colors and styles do not need to match.
Lay the pages out by their labels, and join them with tape on the back.
tips: Give the pages with the simplest outlines to the people who want a quieter task, and the busier ones to anyone who enjoys them.
Hang the wall where everyone can see it, and talk about the parts together.
Choose a smaller wall for a small table, and a bigger one for a room.

faq.q: Is there a timer, a score or a winner?
faq.a: No. Nothing is timed, scored or counted, and nobody wins. The wall is simply a picture that many people colored.

faq.q: Are the pages saved or sent anywhere?
faq.a: No. The wall is made on this page only. It is not saved, uploaded or counted, and it is gone when you close the page.

faq.q: Do the colors have to match?
faq.a: No. Every person can use any colors and any style. The pages still join up into one picture.
Yes. The printed wall is the whole game: a first page with the steps and a map, and one page for each part of the picture.

faq.q: Is it free, and do I need to sign up?
faq.a: Yes, it is free, and there is no account, sign-up or download. It works in the web browser on a phone, tablet or computer.

quiet-shapes.name: Quiet shapes puzzle
quiet-shapes.seoTitle: Quiet Shapes Puzzle: Fit Shapes Into a Picture
quiet-shapes.h1: Quiet Shapes Puzzle: Fit the Pieces into the Picture
quiet-shapes.description: Fit simple shapes into the outline of a house, a boat, a fish and more. Tap a piece, then a space of the same shape. There is no timer or score. Free to play and print.
quiet-shapes.short: Fit simple shapes into a picture, at your own pace.
quiet-shapes.intro: A picture outline, such as a house, a boat or a rocket, is divided into spaces. Each space has a piece of the same shape, a large or small triangle, a square, a parallelogram or a rectangle. Tap a piece, then tap a space of the same shape, and it fits. The space turns the piece for you, so there is nothing to drag or rotate. If a piece is a different shape from a space, it stays in the tray with a short note. Nothing is timed or scored, and nothing is saved or sent. "Print this shape" prints the outline and its pieces on one page to color or cut out.
howTo: Tap a piece in the tray. It shows "Chosen" while it is selected.
Tap a space in the picture. If the shape matches, the piece fits there.
If it does not match, try another space. Nothing is lost by trying.
Tap a piece in the picture to take it back to the tray, or use "Start again" to take all of them back.
When every space has its piece, the picture is complete. Tap "Another shape" for a new one, or tap Rest to stop.
tips: Turn the hint lines on to see each space. Turn them off for more of a puzzle, with only the outline to go by.
Start with the big shapes, such as the large triangles and the rectangles. The small pieces often go last.
Name the shapes out loud as you go: "a triangle, a square, a long rectangle". Talking can make it a shared activity.

faq.q: Are the places big enough for a tremor or a small screen?

faq.q: Is it free, and do I need to sign up?

calm-breathing.name: Bekaa nesewin
calm-breathing.description: Bekaa, mino-nesewin ji-maamaawii-doodamang: wawiye-ayaa gichi-mindidomagad miinawaa agaasaamagad 6 nese-giizhig. Giin gi-maadaadon, miinawaa gidaa-boonitaa aaniin apii.
calm-breathing.short: Wawiye-ayaa ji-wiidookawaad nesewin. Maadaadon miinawaa boonitoon apii menwendaman.
calm-breathing.intro: Aaniin apii maamawi-onizhishin bekaa ji-anwebing. Daminikwen "Maajitaataam", mii dash biindigewebin nesewin apii wawiye-ayaa gichi-mindidomagak, miinawaa maajiiwebin nesewin apii agaasaamagak. Onaabandan bekaa gemaa gizhiikaamagak. Gaawiin mashkikiwi-inakamigasinook, gwayak eta mino-giizhig ji-maamawi-ayaayang.
howTo: Minwaa-namadabig baati-babiizhitaawin.
Onaabandan aaniin ge-zhi-bimaadakamigak: bekaa gemaa noojimowin.
Daminikwen "Maajitaataam". Biindige-nese apii mindidomagak wawiye-ayaa, miinawaa maajiise-nese apii agaasaamagak.
Boonisemagad owi-6 nesewinan, gemaa daminikwen "Boonitaam" aaniin apii menwendaman.

story-chain.name: ᐅᐨᐦᒧᐠ ᐅᐨᐦᒧᐠ
story-chain.h1: Story Chain: Tell a Story One Picture at a Time
story-chain.description: A row of pictures grows one at a time, and each person says a sentence about it aloud. Nothing to type, no right answer. Free, calm, no timer and no score.
story-chain.short: ᐅᐨᐦᒧᐠ ᐅᐨᐦᒧᐠ, ᐅᐨᐦᒧᐠ ᐅᐨᐦᒧᐠ ᐅᐨᐦᒧᐠ ᐅᐨᐦᒧᐠ.
story-chain.intro: The game starts with one picture and grows the chain one picture at a time. Each person says one sentence about the chain so far, out loud, in turn. A sentence can be about what you see, a place it brings to mind, or something silly. Nothing is typed, recorded or kept, there is no right answer, and anyone may pass. The chain stops at eight pictures, and then you can start a new one.

quiet-scene.name: ᐅᐨᐦᒧᐠ ᐅᐨᐦᒧᐠ
quiet-scene.h1: Quiet Scene: One Still Picture at a Time
quiet-scene.description: One large, still picture at a time, each with one gentle line under it. Press Next or Previous when you are ready. Nothing moves or plays on its own, and there is no timer or score. Free to play, with no account.
quiet-scene.short: ᐅᐨᐦᒧᐠ ᐅᐨᐦᒧᐠ ᐅᐨᐦᒧᐠ ᐅᐨᐦᒧᐠ, ᐅᐨᐦᒧᐠ ᐅᐨᐦᒧᐠ.
quiet-scene.intro: One large picture fills the screen, with one short line under it. Press "Next picture" or "Previous picture" when you are ready for another. Nothing moves, fades or changes on its own, and nothing is timed. Tap "Bigger picture" to show only the picture, so the whole room can see it on a television.

color-wash.name: ᐊᓂᔑᓈᐯᒧᐎᓐ ᐅᑭᐠ
color-wash.seoTitle: ᐊᓂᔑᓈᐯᒧᐎᓐ ᐅᑭᐠ: ᐅᓂᐢᐊᓂᐠ ᐊᓂᔑᓈᐯᒧᐎᓐ ᐅᑭᐠ ᐊᓂᔑᓈᐯᒧᐎᓐ
color-wash.description: A soft brush paints wide, see-through washes of color across one page, in four colors and two brush sizes. There is no end point, no score and no timer. Free to play, with no account.
color-wash.short: ᐅᓂᐢᐊᓂᐠ ᐊᓂᔑᓈᐯᒧᐎᓐ ᐅᑭᐠ ᐅᓂᐢᐊᓂᐠ ᐊᓂᔑᓈᐯᒧᐎᓐ ᐅᑭᐠ, ᑭᓂᐠ ᐊᓂᔑᓈᐯᒧᐎᓐ.
color-wash.intro: One page and one soft brush. Choose a color and a brush size, then drag across the page to lay down a wash of color. The page has no end point: there is nothing to finish, no picture to get right and no score. Lay down as many washes as you like, or put the brush down and simply look. A fresh page clears everything, and Put it back brings it back.
